description: Empiric therapy for PICC lines, ports, and HD catheters. Mapped from DKR central_line_infection.json; TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02. Distinct from bacteremia.json hospital-acquired / central-line bacteremia category.

conditional_adjuncts.condition: Patient receives TPN via central line for >7 days
conditional_adjuncts.note: TODO: micafungin is named in DKR but has no monograph in guidelines/drugs/

regimens.reasoning: Cefepime plus vancomycin first-line for PICC/port/HD catheter infection (TUH 2025-04-02 rank 1)
regimens.evidence: TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02
regimens.note: Add micafungin if TPN via central line >7 days (TODO: micafungin not in guidelines/drugs/). Consider line removal whenever feasible.
